results.title: Analytic Greeks vs finite differences

results.name: implied_vol
results.title: Price -> implied volatility -> price round trip
results.tolerance: price round trip atol=1e-09, rtol=1e-09; vol atol=1e-08, rtol=0 where vega>=0.5; solver agreement 1e-09
results.notes: 4032 grid prices solved by each method. Converged: 3936; well-conditioned (vega>=0.5): 3260; max |vol error| on those: bisection 2.15e-13, brentq 2.50e-13; max |bisection-brentq|: 4.61e-13; vectorised vs scalar vol max diff 2.67e-13 on 3260 well-conditioned lanes; vectorised price round trip max error 2.84e-14 on all 3936 converged lanes (676 of them have vega < 0.5, where the vol is not identifiable and only the price is compared). Not solved: 96 (all within 1e-06 of a model bound: True). Max utilisation is for the price round trip. [0.4s]

results.name: mc_accuracy
results.title: Monte Carlo vs analytic, in standard errors
results.notes: 180 contracts x 6 quantities, 200,000 paths, antithetic. Over the 1079 cases with non-degenerate standard error: mean z = -0.018, std of z = 0.976, max |z| = 3.52 (a correct estimator with correct standard errors gives about 0, 1 and 3 to 3.5 for ~1000 samples). 1 case(s) have a zero-variance estimator (exact result) and are judged by the absolute floor only. [0.5s]

results.name: mc_repeated_seeds
results.title: Monte Carlo behaviour across repeated seeds
results.tolerance: pooled coverage in (0.93, 0.97); per-case coverage in (0.88, 0.995); mean SE / empirical std in (0.85, 1.15); |bias z| <= 4
results.notes: 8 contracts x 1000 seeds x 20,000 paths (antithetic). Pooled 95% coverage: 0.963. [4.2s]

results.name: mc_variance_reduction
results.title: Antithetic variates at equal simulation budget
results.tolerance: plain variance / antithetic variance >= 0.95 (variances = mean reported SE^2 over seeds)
results.notes: Same 20,000 paths per estimate, 1000 seeds each. Variance ratio (plain/antithetic, from mean reported SE^2): min 1.14, median 1.80, max 5.36. The 'empirical_ratio' column uses the spread of estimates across seeds instead; it is much noisier for skewed payoffs (high-vol OTM options), so it is shown but not used for pass/fail. Max error / allowed column shows the minimum ratio. [4.2s]

results.name: mc_reproducibility
results.title: Monte Carlo reproducibility and independent streams
results.notes: same seed -> identical price and Greeks: ok; different seed -> different price: ok; 1, 2 and 4 workers -> bitwise identical price and Greeks: ok; spawned streams uncorrelated (|corr|=0.0034 <= 0.0089): ok; (contrast) naive same-seed workers would be identical streams: ok [0.5s]
